newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle turn brisk at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle turn brisk at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderately active in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 18,800 slaughter steers and 11,300 heifers; 30,100 head confirmed for the week which includes 12,200 formulated and 1,700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 69.00-69.75.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00-69.50. Confirmed - 30,100 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 4,500
Wk to Date - 54,800 Week Ago - 91,400 Year Ago - 83,500
